clusterService.description: an in-cluster HTTPS service to call instead of an internet provider, such as Ollama or vLLM, at the baseUrl path, its certificate issued for the baseUrl host

baseUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible API root of the provider, such as https://api.openai.com/v1: an https URL; the install shows its host and the grant approves it

timeout.description: The longest one call to the provider may take, at most 2m

location.description: Where the models of the provider run: on hardware the owner runs, or in the cloud of a third party

days.description: Days the provider keeps requests and answers; 0 for none

mayTrain.description: Whether the provider may train on what it receives

inputPrice.description: Price per million input tokens, a decimal string

outputPrice.description: Price per million output tokens, a decimal string
